hypothesis: Machine learning (ML) techniques can significantly enhance the measurement and understanding of climate adaptation by providing flexible modeling approaches that account for complex relationships between climate variables and economic outcomes, particularly in agriculture. By integrating ML with existing climate models, researchers can better assess the extent of adaptation to climate change impacts, such as damaging heat exposure on crop yields, thereby informing policy interventions and improving resilience strategies [climate-adaptation-ml:0][tackling-climate-ml:7.3].
